buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Malicious Code Certificate: The seller should upload following certificate in the bid:- (a) This is to certify that the Hardware and the Software being offered, as part of the contract, does not contain Embedded Malicious code that would activate procedures to :- (i) Inhibit the desires and designed function of the equipment. (ii) Cause physical damage to the user or equipment during the exploitation. (iii) Tap information resident or transient in the equipment/network. (b) The firm will be considered to be in breach of the procurement contract, in case physical damage, loss

of information or infringements related to copyright and Intellectual Property Right (IPRs) are caused due to activation of any such malicious code in embedded software. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Additional Terms and Condition: 1. System Compatibility: The equipment offered by the bidder m ust be fully compatible with the existing Audio-Visual (AV) infrastru cture already deployed in the Academy. It is the bidder’s responsibi lity to ensure that all proposed hardware, software, control system s, and network interfaces can integrate seamlessly with the existin g setup without requiring major modifications or additional compon ents. Any incompatibility found after the contract is awarded will no t be accepted. 2. Site Visit – Highly Recommended : All prospective bidders mu st conduct a site visit/site survey before participating in the bid to a ssess the existing IT and AV infrastructure, compatibility of the pro posed solution, site conditions, space and functional requirements, and any other site-specific requirements. The site visit will also ena ble bidders to understand the scope of work and technical require ments. No claim for additional payment arising out of any misunder standing or failure to assess the site conditions shall be entertained after award of the contract. In view of campus security, interested bidders shall obtain prior ap proval for the site visit by sending a request through email at sudhi r@svpnpa.gov.in or by contacting 040-24234598. The site visit may be requested on any working day before the bid closing date. Bidders are advised to complete the site visit before participating i n the bid and to carefully examine all terms and conditions. 3. Pre-Bid Meeting : A Pre-Bid Meeting will be conducted online/off line on 02.11.2026 at 11:00 AM to clarify the scope of work, tech nical specifications and other bid-related requirements. Interested bidders who wish to attend the Pre-Bid Meeting online or offline shall submit their request through email at sudhir@svpnpa.g ov.in or contact 040-24234598. The mode of participation (online/o ffline) may be requested in advance by the interested bidder. 4. Responsibility for All Works: The selected bidder will be fully

responsible for the complete execution of the project (including civi l and Electrical works). This includes the supply, delivery, installatio n, configuration, integration, testing, and commissioning of all requ ired AV, IT and electrical component required for installation of the offered product. The scope also includes any civil works such as dri lling or minor carpentry, any electrical works including power cabling or sockets/MCBs, HDMI Cable, CAT Cable, Rx and TX and an y IT or networking activities necessary to complete the project. The bidder must arrange all tools, safety equipment, manpower, softwa re licenses, and other resources necessary for timely and safe exec ution. (Successful bidder has to supply and install all the ne cessary accessories to complete the project including one g ood quality minimum 20-meter Active HDMI Cable having so urce and Display connector and one good quality minimum 10-meter power cable with 15 Ampere male power socket a nd female power board. Also, 34/48/64 Ampere MCB along with board will be supplied for each screen) 5. Technical Data sheet (along with screen diagram) of the offered product must be submitted with the bid. 6. Certification of Product Support: The bidder must ensure th at the quoted equipment is the latest model in current production a nd is not near its end-of-life. The certificate must also confirm that all quoted products will be supported with spare parts, firmware an d software updates, and service facilities for a minimum of eight ye ars after the expiry of the warranty period. This support may be on a chargeable basis or under an Annual Maintenance Contract. 7. OEM Authorization: An OEM Authorization Certificate must be submitted along with the bid. The certificate must specifically refer ence this tender and confirm that the bidder is an authorized partn er, dealer, distributor, or system integrator for the quoted products . It must further authorize the bidder to supply, install, and provide after-sales support for the said equipment. Failure to include this c ertificate may lead to rejection of the bid during technical evaluatio n. 8. Warranty Terms: All equipment supplied shall carry a minimu m five (05) years on-site warranty from the date of final acce ptance of the complete installed system by the Academy. Fi nal acceptance of the product will be consider after the successful i

nstallation. During the warranty period, the successful bidder shall be responsi ble for attending to faults and failures, providing technical assistan ce and repairing/replacing defective hardware/software component s covered under warranty. The bidder shall also ensure availability of applicable firmware/soft ware updates during the warranty period. 9. After-Sales Service Commitment: Service support by the bid der and OEM will be provided during both the warranty and post- w arranty periods, whether on an AMC or chargeable basis, as decide d by the Academy. The maximum permitted downtime for any equi pment failure shall be four hours. In case of failure to restore s ervice within this time, the Academy reserves the right to g et the system repaired through a third party, and the cost i ncurred will be deducted from the Earnest Performance Ba nk Guarantee (EPBG) or any outstanding payment due to th e bidder. There will be no compromise with after sales servi ce. 10. Local Service Support: The bidder/OEM must have a fully op erational service centre located in Hyderabad or elsewhere in Telan gana. Proof of the service centre’s address and contact details mus t be submitted with the bid. The service centre must be staffed wit h qualified technical personnel and must have the capacity to provi de spare parts and maintenance support within the defined service levels. [Note: Kindly provide the name and working mobile number of the Local Service Centre/technician]. 11. Demonstration / Technical Presentation: If desired by the Technical Purchase Committee, shortlisted bidders must be prepar ed to conduct a technical presentation explaining the proposed sys tem, its architecture, key features, and implementation methodolo gy. In addition, if desired by the TPC, a physical demonstratio n or Proof of Concept of critical components may be reques ted. The presentation or demonstration must be arranged a t short notice and at the bidder’s own expense. Demonstrat ion must clearly show that the solution is capable of handli ng all input media. This includes compatibility with all types of la ptops—both latest and older models, including Apple/Mac Books—a s well as iPads, mobile phones with varying screen resolutions, and different video input types such as HDMI, VGA, USB-C, wireless or a

ny other latest input option. The demonstration should confirm that the system functions seamlessly across all these devices. 12. Post-Delivery Inspection: The buyer reserves the right to in spect and test the delivered equipment after installation and com missioning, even if the equipment has passed technical evaluation. Final acceptance will be granted only after the system is found to b e fully functional, complies with all specified requirements, and per forms satisfactorily under real-use conditions. The bidder must add ress any deficiencies at their own cost. 13. Training: The selected bidder must provide hands-on training to the Academy’s designated staff members. The training must cov er complete system operation, user interface handling, basic troubl eshooting, and regular maintenance tasks. Training must be provid ed on-site and should include instructional materials such as user manuals and quick reference guides. The objective is to ensure tha t staff can operate and manage the system independently after ha ndover. 14. MII preference: As per the Government of India’s Make in Ind ia (MII) policy, all bidders are required to ensure accurate local valu e addition before declaring themselves as Class-I or Class-II local s uppliers. Certifications should not be submitted blindly for the purp ose of gaining procurement preference. Please note that bidders of fering imported products will fall under the category of non-local su ppliers. They can't claim themselves as Class-I local suppliers/Class -II local suppliers by claiming the services such as transportation, in surance, installation, commissioning, training and after sales servic e support like AMC/CMC etc. as local value addition. 15. MSE Preference: All bidders seeking MSE preference under p ublic procurement policy are requested to ensure possession of a v alid MSME certificate. The bidder must be the actual manufacturer of the offered product and must hold a valid MSME certificate unde r the manufacturing category. Merely acting as a supplier, trader, o r reseller does not entitle the bidder to claim MSE preference benef its. MSE preference is strictly applicable only to manufacturers of t he quoted product, as per prevailing Government of India guideline s. 16. Import of the above product or any of its components/a ccessories from countries subject to import bans or restrict ions imposed by the Government of India (GOI), if any, is st

rictly prohibited. 17. If any time (even after the installation of the goods/pro duct), it came to notice that the product offered by the bid der is not as per the specification and necessary terms and condition (including MII compliance and MSE compliance et c), the bidder/supplier is liable to face the penalty or any ot her actions (debarment/blacklisting etc) as per applicable r ules amended from time to time. LIQUIDATED DAMAGES /PENALTY CLAUSE: a) If the contractor fails to supply/installation the items within the ti me as mentioned in the contract the contractor shall be liable to pa y the liquidated damage (LD)/penalty charges at the rate 0.5 % (ha lf percent) of the total cost of the contract per week subject to a m aximum of 10% (Ten percent) of the total cost of contract. b) The Director SVP NPA reserves the right to cancel & terminate t his contract at any time, after commencement of the work, if the w ork performed by the approved firm is not satisfactory. If after com mencement of work the contract is terminated for unsatisfactory w ork, then security deposit shall be forfeited to the SVPNPA in additi on to recovery of penalty. c)Penalty for delay in completion of the work shall be recoverable f rom the bills of the vendor. NOTE: A Prebid meeting will be held online/offline on date mentioned in the Prebid column of the bid document. Intere sted bidder can requested for offline/online by emailing the ir request through email sudhir@svpnpa.gov.in and phone No. 040-24234598. Site visit can be requested any day befo re closing of the bid (requested to do site visit before partic ipating in the bid and reading all the terms and conditions) through email sudhir@svpnpa.gov.in and phone No. 040-24 234598. CHECK LIST BEFORE SUBMITTING THE BID:

1. Ensure Submitting EMD, if asked. You can also claim for EMD e xemption as per General Terms and conditions on GeM. Please no te that if you are claiming for EMD exemption under MSEs c ategory, you must have valid Udyam Registration and are manufacturer of the offered product or Service (Primary pr oduct/Service). For other methods of EMD exemption kindly refer to the General Terms and conditions on GeM. 2. Experience criteria: In respect of the filter applied for experienc e criteria, the Bidder or its OEM of the product offered in the bid {themselves or through reseller(s)} should have regularly, manufa ctured and supplied same or similar Category Products to any Cent ral / State Govt Organization / PSU for number of financial years as indicated above in the bid document before the bid opening date. Copies of relevant contracts and delivery acceptance certifi cates like CRAC to be submitted along with bid in support o f having supplied some quantity during each of the financia l year. In case of bunch bids, the category of primary product havi ng highest value should meet this criterion. 3. Past performance: The Bidder or its OEM {themselves or throug h re-seller(s)} should have supplied same or similar Category Products for 30% of bid quantity, in at least one of the last three financial years before the bid opening date to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU. Copies of relevant contracts (provi ng supply of cumulative order quantity in any one financial year) to be submitted along with bid in support of quantity supplied in the r elevant financial year. In case of bunch bids, the category related t o primary product having highest bid value should meet this criteri on. 4. OEM Authorization Certificate. 5. MSEs preference: If the bidder wants to avail themselves of the Purchase preference, the bidder must be the manufacturer / O EM of the offered product on GeM. Traders are excluded from t he purview of Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterp rises and hence resellers offering products manufactured by some

other OEM are not eligible for any purchase preference. In respect of bid for Services, the bidder must be the Service provider of the o ffered Service. Relevant documentary evidence in this regard shall be uploaded along with the bid in respect of the offered product or service and Buyer will decide eligibility for purchase preference ba sed on documentary evidence submitted, while evaluating the bid. 6. MII Preference: If the bidder wants to avail the Purchase prefere nce, the bidder must upload a certificate from the OEM regard ing the percentage of the local content and the details of lo cations at which the local value addition is made along with their bid, failing which no purchase preference shall be granted. 7. Kindy attach ATC Acceptance Certificate. 8. Kindly submit the Malicious code certificate separately. 9. Kindly attach proof of OEM/Bidder service centre Hyd/Tela ngana. 10. Kindly submit the scope of work. Kindly attach Data Sheet of the offered product. K .
